feat(evals): also write each run's results outside the checkout (#195)

Every live run that finishes writes its .json/.md pair to --out and then to
$XDG_STATE_HOME/serverless-ai-scheduling/eval-results/<checkout>/ (or
~/.local/state/...), overridable with EVAL_RESULTS_COPY_DIR. A copy directory
inside the repository is a usage error; the directory is created before the
first model call; a failed copy write warns without changing the exit code.
